title: Age Calculator
description: Find your exact age in years, months, and days, plus how long until your next birthday.

faqs.question: How is age calculated down to the day?
faqs.answer: We subtract your date of birth from the calculation date, carrying over days into months and months into years the same way you'd do it by hand.

faqs.question: Can I calculate age as of a future or past date?
faqs.answer: Yes — set the 'Calculate Age As Of' field to any date to see the age at that point in time.
